versions.content:
[SWS_CM_00700] Ensure memory allocation of maxSampleCount sam- ples
⌈
The Communication Management shall ensure, that after returning from method
Subscribe sufficient memory resources are available, so that the number of samples given in parameter maxSampleCount can be concurrently accessed by application
layer, otherwise error handling according to [SWS_CORE_00001] shall be performed.
⌋
